notes: Both mey ha-niddah phrases have their article morpheme on the rectum while the ASV renders the rectum anarthrously, so the article takes the fronted the under rule 29.
mazzeh is an anarthrous substantival participle and heads on the lexeme under rule 46, while ha-noge'a carries an article and heads on the supplied pronoun under rule 41; the contrast is deliberate.
The resultative lamed is unrepresented, the copula having gone to hayah (rule 21), and the article on erev is unrepresented, the ASV writing until even.
